description: This file defines the ForTokenParser class, which is responsible for parsing 'for' loop tags in Twig templates, converting them into ForNode objects that represent loop structures in the template syntax.

classes.name: ForTokenParser
classes.description: A class that parses 'for' loop tags in Twig templates and creates corresponding ForNode instances.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a 'for' tag in the template, handling loop variables, sequence, optional else block, and returns a ForNode.

methods.name: decideForFork
methods.description: Determines if the current token indicates the start of an 'else' or 'endfor' block.

methods.name: decideForEnd
methods.description: Determines if the current token indicates the end of the 'for' loop.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name 'for' that this parser handles.
